question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH line_groups AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
      WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG), ' ', '')) IN ('NON-VEG', 'NONVEG') THEN 'Non-Veg'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS food_group,
    COUNT(*) AS item_line_count,
    SUM(i.QUANTITY) AS ordered_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM i
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_FOOD f
    ON i.FOOD_ID = f.FOOD_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(ordered_units) AS total_ordered_units
  FROM line_groups
)
SELECT
  g.food_group,
  g.item_line_count,
  g.ordered_units,
  t.total_ordered_units,
  100.0 * g.ordered_units / NULLIF(t.total_ordered_units, 0) AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct
FROM line_groups g
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY CASE g.food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

action.answer:
For item lines belonging to orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025, classification by the joined food dimension:

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of total ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null or unmatched food ID) | 12 | 13 | 0.000106% |

The denominator is 12,230,877 ordered units across all three groups. Shares are each group’s ordered units divided by that denominator, multiplied by 100; displayed percentages may not sum exactly to 100% because of rounding.
